levels.name: Entry Level
levels.roles: Workers, Drivers, Technicians, Assistant Technicians, Specialists

levels.name: Middle Management
levels.roles: Head of Departments, Shift Leaders, Section Heads

core_competencies.name: Communication & Influence
core_competencies.definition: Interacting with others openly and effectively demonstrating accuracy, transparency, and clarity.

levels.1: Expresses perspective clearly; listens to others; uses appropriate body language.
levels.2: Conveys meaning concisely; seeks to influence others; prevents arguments in discussions.
levels.3: Conveys complex issues simply; balances speaking/listening; builds sustainable relationships.
levels.4: Models persuasive strategies; drives cross-departmental communication; understands group dynamics.

core_competencies.name: Collaboration & Teamwork
core_competencies.definition: Communicating within and across groups to create alignment and share information.

levels.1: Shows respect; shares expertise; values input from others; encourages sharing views.
levels.2: Communicates clear vision; creates sharing environment; works towards consensus-based solutions.
levels.3: Facilitates cross-functional teams; removes barriers; fosters collaboration across teams.
levels.4: Enhances outcomes through partnerships; drives fair culture; accessible despite seniority.

1.name: Adaptability
1.definition: Adjusting behaviors to work efficiently in light of new information or environments.

levels.1: Seeks guidance in new situations; works in different conditions; adheres to rules.

1.name: Punctuality & Accountability
1.definition: Responsibility for timeliness, commitment to tasks, and adherence to standards.

levels.1: Follows attendance rules; meets deadlines; takes responsibility for own work.

1.name: Health & Safety Awareness
1.definition: Adherence to health and safety laws to maintain a safe work environment.

levels.1: Organizes workspace safely; adheres to procedural instructions.

1.name: Taking Initiative & Drive for Results
1.definition: Proactively taking action to address problems and achieve KPIs.

levels.1: Demonstrates 'can do' attitude; committed to deadlines; persists if initial attempts fail.

2.name: Taking Initiative & Drive for Results
2.definition: Proactively taking action to address problems and achieve KPIs.

levels.2: Acts quickly in sensitive situations; monitors KPIs; takes remedial action.

2.name: Continuous Learning
2.definition: Identifying strengths/weaknesses to enhance personal and team performance.

levels.2: Self-assesses; seeks feedback; pursues learning opportunities; integrates new learning.

2.name: Punctuality & Accountability
2.definition: Responsibility for timeliness, commitment to tasks, and adherence to standards.

levels.2: Ensures team meets deadlines; takes measures to address group shortcomings.

2.name: Health & Safety Awareness
2.definition: Adherence to health and safety laws to maintain a safe work environment.

levels.2: Monitors safety standards; identifies and reports hazards.

3.name: Coaching & Leading Others
3.definition: Encouraging performance and fulfilling skill requirements of individuals and the organization.

levels.3: Suggests development activities; coaches through feedback; leads by example.

3.name: Supervision
3.definition: Overseeing team performance and ensuring adherence to organizational standards.

levels.3: Monitors team performance; provides constructive feedback; ensures compliance with policies.

3.name: Initiation
3.definition: Starting new projects and driving organizational change and improvement.

levels.3: Identifies improvement opportunities; proposes new initiatives; drives implementation.

3.name: Problem Solving & Decision Making
3.definition: Analyzing complex issues and making sound decisions based on available information.

levels.3: Analyzes root causes; evaluates alternatives; makes timely decisions; considers stakeholder impact.

4.name: Results Orientation
4.definition: Focusing on achieving organizational goals and delivering measurable outcomes.

levels.4: Sets ambitious goals; drives accountability; celebrates achievements; measures success.

4.name: Problem Solving & Decision Making
4.definition: Analyzing complex issues and making sound decisions based on available information.

levels.4: Addresses strategic challenges; makes decisions under uncertainty; considers long-term implications.

4.name: Visioning & Strategic Thinking
4.definition: Creating a compelling vision for the future and developing long-term strategies.

levels.4: Articulates clear vision; aligns teams with strategy; anticipates market trends; builds sustainable advantage.

4.name: Conflict Management
4.definition: Addressing disagreements constructively and maintaining positive relationships.

levels.4: Mediates conflicts; finds win-win solutions; maintains team cohesion; models respectful dialogue.
